Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner correctly identified the directors and birthdates in Step 9 (Orestis Laskos born 1907-11-11 and Sam Irvin born 1956-06-14). However, in Step 10, the Planner made a critical logical error by swapping the names associated with the birthdates. It stated that Orestis Laskos was born on 1956-06-14 and Sam Irvin was born on 1907-11-11. This misattribution led to the incorrect conclusion that Allos Gia To Ekatommyrio (Laskos) had the later-born director, when in reality, Elvira's Haunted Hills (Irvin) has the later-born director.
